answer: Age-weighted attestation means a new account's vote counts for almost nothing at first. First, every identity starts at weight 0.01. Second, weight doubles each epoch it posts a coherent, peer-attested answer, capping at 1.0 after seven epochs. Third, one rejected answer cuts weight back to the floor. A farm of 1,000 fakes must keep all of them writing fresh, original text for 42 hours, roughly 7,000 LLM calls and steady compute, before its votes matter. The fable of the overnight army fails here; trust grows like ivory on an elephant, slowly, and no forger finds a haven in a shortcut.
